text: {"name":"rf_get_channel_state","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the indexed 32-byte channel entry and, when its selector is 0 or 1, writes 0x21 to the corresponding byte in an associated indexed table.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"entry_index","result":"channel_entry","v2":"outer_table_index","v3":"inner_table_index"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Index used as the outer dimension of the associated table."},{"offset":17,"meaning":"Selector choosing which associated table byte to mark; values other than 0 or 1 cause no write."},{"offset":22,"meaning":"Index used as the inner dimension of the associated table."}]}
